## Parties

This Mutual Confidentiality Agreement is entered into by and between Vantage Shoal Marine Ltd ("First Party") and Alder Wharf Labs Ltd ("Second Party"), each referred to individually as a "Party" and together as the "Parties". This Agreement takes effect on 19 September 2026 (the "Effective Date") and is entered into in connection with the Parties' discussions and dealings concerning a distribution deal (the "Purpose").

## Confidential Information

"Confidential Information" means any information disclosed by one Party (the "Disclosing Party") to the other Party (the "Receiving Party") in connection with the Purpose, whether disclosed orally, in writing, electronically, visually or by any other means, and whether or not marked or identified as confidential at the time of disclosure. Confidential Information includes, without limitation, business plans, distribution strategies, pricing, margins, territory and channel information, customer and supplier details, forecasts, financial information, technical data, designs, know-how, and the existence and contents of the discussions between the Parties regarding the Purpose. Confidential Information does not include information that: (a) is or becomes publicly available other than through breach of this Agreement by the Receiving Party; (b) was lawfully in the Receiving Party's possession, free of any obligation of confidence, before disclosure by the Disclosing Party; (c) is lawfully received from a third party who is free to disclose it; or (d) is independently developed by the Receiving Party without use of or reference to the Confidential Information.

## Obligations

Each Receiving Party shall hold the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information in strict confidence and shall use it solely for the Purpose. The Receiving Party shall not disclose Confidential Information to any third party without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party, except to its directors, officers, employees and professional advisers who need to know it for the Purpose and who are bound by obligations of confidentiality no less protective than those set out in this Agreement. The Receiving Party shall apply at least the same degree of care to the Confidential Information as it applies to its own confidential information of like importance, and in no event less than a reasonable degree of care, and remains responsible for any breach by those to whom it discloses. The Receiving Party shall promptly notify the Disclosing Party of any unauthorised use or disclosure of which it becomes aware. Disclosure required by law, regulation or court order is permitted, provided the Receiving Party gives prompt written notice where lawful to do so and discloses only what is required. On written request, the Receiving Party shall return or destroy the Confidential Information in its possession.

## Term

This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for a term of 24 months.

## Governing Law

This Agreement and any dispute arising out of or in connection with it are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Ontario.
